content:
Apple TV's three-part documentary series about the University of Connecticut women's basketball team is now available to stream. Check out the trailer below.

《Dynasty: UConn Huskies》premiered on Apple TV

Apple TV subscribers can now stream all three episodes of 《Dynasty: UConn Huskies》, a brand-new sports documentary series on Apple TV.

《Dynasty: UConn Huskies》features interviews with "coaches, athletes, alumni, rivals, and journalists across multiple eras of UConn basketball," and is directed by Matthew Hamachek (who worked on 《Tiger》) and Erica Sashin (who worked on 《Wrong Man》).

Here's how Apple TV describes the show:

《Dynasty: UConn Huskies》will join Apple TV's growing lineup of sports content, which includes 《Ted Lasso》, 《The Dink》, 《Stick》, 《F1 The Movie》, 《Fight for Glory: 2024 World Series》, 《Onside: Major League Soccer》, 《Messi's World Cup: The Rise of a Legend》, and 《Stephen Curry: Underrated》.

Apple TV this morning also confirmed the return date for 《Stick》 and announced a new cast member who should be familiar to fans of the platform's hit series 《Pluribus》.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, or it can be bundled via Apple One. The platform offers a wide range of popular series and films, including 《Ted Lasso》, 《Severance》, 《The Studio》, 《The Morning Show》, 《Shrinking》, and 《Silo》.
